title: Inside DynamicPage, one step at a time
intro: The dot is the call moving between components. Press Play, or step through manually (arrow keys work too).

flows.label: goto
flows.summary: From a page name in a test to a navigation in the browser.

steps.title: The test names a page
steps.text: Before this line, the test found an in-stock product through the API and stored its id in sharedData. Now it only names the page it wants.

steps.title: goto looks the name up
steps.text: The page name is a key in the client's registry. An unknown name fails here, with the client's name in the message, before anything else happens.

steps.title: The client registered the page
steps.text: client.pages maps each name to a config factory: a function that takes a Page and returns the page's sections and fields.

steps.title: The config is built for this test
steps.text: The factory runs on every goto, against this test's page. Locators are fresh, and nothing is cached or shared between tests running in parallel.

steps.title: onPageInit runs once per test
steps.text: On the first goto only, the client gets a hook for one-time browser setup. With skipNavigation, goto would stop right after this: the config is switched and the browser doesn't move.

steps.title: SharedData fills the placeholder
steps.text: The config's url is /product/${productId}. Each placeholder is replaced from the test's SharedData. A missing value throws here, before navigating (see the next tab).

steps.title: The path meets the environment
steps.text: The path is resolved against the client's base URL for the current TEST_ENV, so the same test runs against dev or staging without changes.

steps.title: The browser navigates, with retry
steps.text: Navigation waits for domcontentloaded, not networkidle, and is retried up to 3 times. Readiness is checked later, through the elements the test actually uses.

flows.label: goto: missing value
flows.summary: The same call when the test forgot to store the product id.

steps.title: The test skipped a step
steps.text: Imagine the API step was removed, so nothing ever called sharedData.set('productId', ...). The goto call itself looks exactly the same.

steps.title: Lookup and config work as usual
steps.text: The page exists, so its config is built. Nothing is wrong yet.

steps.title: The placeholder has no value
steps.text: replacePlaceholders asks SharedData for productId and finds nothing. Instead of building /product/undefined, it throws, with the placeholder's name in the message. The browser never navigates.
steps.code: throw new Error(`No shared data value for URL placeholder "${match}"`);

flows.label: executeSection
flows.summary: How two entries of test data become a fill and a click.

steps.title: The test passes data, not locators
steps.text: Two fields of the purchase section: a quantity to fill and a button to click. The order of the keys is the order they run in.

steps.title: The engine walks the data
steps.text: The loop goes over the keys of the test's data. Fields the test leaves out simply don't run.

steps.title: Each key is looked up in the config
steps.text: The field gives a locator and an ordered list of actions. A key the config doesn't have fails with the section and field names.

steps.title: Each action is found by name
steps.text: quantity's action is 'fill'. The name is looked up in one map; an unknown name fails with the section and field in the message.

steps.title: The map includes the client's actions
steps.text: The map was built once, from the built-in actions and then the client's. A client action with a built-in name replaces it.

steps.title: fill goes to InputActions
steps.text: The built-in fill turns the value into a string and calls InputActions.

steps.title: The value is typed, then checked
steps.text: Playwright waits for the field and fills it. Then the wrapper confirms the value stayed, because masked fields sometimes change what was typed.

steps.title: addToCart goes to ElementActions
steps.text: The next key, addToCart, maps to click. The wrapper only logs; Playwright's click already waits until the button is visible, stable and enabled.

steps.title: Two entries, two actions
steps.text: Every action runs through the same call, with the config's fixed value if it has one, or the test's value otherwise.
